description: Pattern Completion is a crucial part of Non-Verbal Reasoning. It involves an incomplete figure where one-fourth of the part is missing. Students must select the correct piece from the options that completes the pattern of the main figure.

sections.title: Basic Concepts
sections.description: To understand the pattern correctly, knowledge of some basic visual concepts is essential.

key_concepts.explanation: The property of shapes where folding the figure horizontally, vertically, or diagonally results in identical halves.
The progression of lines and curves present in the incomplete part in the same continuous flow.
The turning of internal elements of the figure at a specific angle in a clockwise or anti-clockwise direction.

sections.title: Types of Pattern Symmetry
sections.description: The figures provided in the questions follow various types of symmetry.

results: When all four quadrants of the figure are exactly identical.
The missing part is a direct copy of any existing part.
The left part is a mirror image of the right part, or the top is a mirror image of the bottom.
To complete the pattern, find the reflection of the adjacent part.
The opposite quadrants are identical or mirror images of each other.
Look at the diagonally opposite part to find the missing piece.

sections.title: Steps to Solve
sections.description: The method to solve Pattern Completion questions in exams with accuracy and speed.

steps.title: Observe the Incomplete Part
steps.detail: Carefully look at the given question figure and focus on the blank space.

steps.title: Identify the Pattern
steps.detail: Analyze the rule of symmetry or direction used in the overall figure.

steps.title: Mental Visualization
steps.detail: Without looking at the options, mentally outline the shape that would perfectly fit in the blank space.

steps.title: Eliminate the Options
steps.detail: Immediately eliminate options that do not match the direction, size, or continuous lines of the main figure.

sections.title: Important Elements and Errors
sections.description: While selecting the correct option, it is necessary to pay attention to small but important visual elements.

key_concepts.explanation: Note the sequence of black, white, or shaded regions in the figure to maintain the pattern.
The size of the shape given in the option must be in exact proportion to the blank space of the question figure.
Usually, the correct option should fit exactly into the blank space without any rotation, unless the question specifically follows a rotating pattern.
